title: Graph Engineering cited claim and its verification
description: A claim span bound to sources, together with exactly one verification per citation in citation order. The four outcomes are distinct on purpose: a citation that exists and is reachable but does not support the claim is 'insufficient', never 'inaccessible', and a citation that cannot be resolved at all is 'inaccessible', never 'insufficient'. Reporting a real source cited for something it never said as a merely missing citation hides the more dangerous failure. Every temporal quantity is a durable sequence number; no wall clock participates.

claimHash.description: SHA-256 over frame('graphengineering.claim.v1alpha1') || frame(canonicalSerialize(claim without claimHash)).

criterionId.description: Present when the claim is bound to a rubric criterion whose citationRequired is true.

claimSpan.description: The exact claim span inside the reviewed document, in Unicode code points.

verifications.description: Exactly one entry per citation, in citation order. A verification is emitted even when the harness itself made the source unreachable; it is never skipped.

contentDigest.description: sha256(utf8(source text)), unframed: it digests opaque source bytes rather than a structured record with forgeable field boundaries.

excerpt.description: The permitted excerpt, addressed in Unicode code points. An over-limit excerpt is refused rather than truncated: truncating would produce a digest matching nothing and would silently change what was cited.

retrievedAtSequence.description: A durable event sequence number, never a wall-clock time. Freshness is a comparison of sequence numbers and declaredVersion, so a conformance case can never depend on when it ran.

supportMode.description: Present iff outcome is 'supported'. Direct support and inference are different claims about the same source.

defects.description: Ordered by the vocabulary's declaration order and unique, so two conforming implementations that find the same defects emit the same list. Empty iff outcome is 'supported'.

networkUsed.description: Always false in conformance. Normal CI uses frozen local sources only.

externalAvailabilityReported.description: True when the unreachability is a property of the harness rather than of the source, so that a disabled network is reported honestly instead of being read as a missing source.
